features.description: Shared status taxonomy and ActionItem provider model. Add a small core module that maps subsystem-specific states into four bands (`ready`, `advisory`, `needs_action`, `info`) and exposes a stable `ActionItem` envelope consumed by dashboard, cache, and future MCP. Providers gather gates needing approval, capability setup/blocked states, reconcile drift, and active supervisor/stuck states. V0 may render architecture stale as an action if detected, but does not embed architecture HTML.
steps: Inventory current state sources: state_projection streams, gate-state.json, capabilities-status cache, reconcile check JSON, active supervisors, architecture status.
Define `ActionItem` fields: id, source, band, title, detail, exact_command, automatable, human_required_reason, evidence_uri, updated_at.
Define taxonomy mapping for gates, capabilities, reconcile statuses, supervisors, and architecture drift into ready/advisory/needs_action/info.
Implement pure provider functions with no mutation and deterministic ordering.
Add JSON renderer/cache writer for `~/.dontpanic/dashboard/what-now.json` or equivalent operator-local cache path.
Add tests for taxonomy mappings, action ordering, no-secret fields, empty state, and multi-source aggregation.
features.acceptance: (1) A typed/shared ActionItem model exists and is documented in code. (2) Providers cover gates, capabilities, reconcile drift, and active supervisors. (3) Four-band taxonomy is the only dashboard status language used by V0 provider output. (4) Provider output is deterministic and secret-free. (5) Cache JSON is stable for agents. (6) Tests cover mappings, ordering, empty state, no-secret invariant, and aggregation.

features.description: Local dashboard CLI. Add `dontpanic dashboard build|open|serve`. `build` exports state, capability status, reconcile status, and what-now cache into dashboard/state. `open` builds then opens or prints the local file/URL. `serve` runs a localhost-only lightweight HTTP server with file-watch/periodic refresh so operator actions appear without manual rebuild. The server writes cache files for agents/headless consumers and does not expose remote interfaces by default.
steps: Add CLI routing for `dontpanic dashboard build`, `open`, and `serve`.
Implement build as composition of existing state export, capabilities status cache, reconcile check, architecture status check, and F001 action cache writer.
Implement serve as localhost-only with explicit host/port flags and safe defaults; no Firebase, no auth, no remote binding by default.
Use a file-watch or periodic refresh loop that rebuilds state after relevant plan/dashboard source changes.
Implement open behavior that prints the URL/path even if GUI open is unavailable in sandboxed/headless contexts.
Add tests for build outputs, serve host default, no remote exposure default, missing optional inputs, and help text.
features.acceptance: (1) `dontpanic dashboard build` writes dashboard/state files plus what-now cache. (2) `dontpanic dashboard open` builds and prints a usable local URL/path. (3) `dontpanic dashboard serve` binds localhost by default and refreshes without requiring manual rebuild. (4) No Firebase config is required or mentioned as a V0 requirement. (5) Tests cover build/open/serve safety and missing optional inputs.
